title: Min Engine Version
description: Validates and updates the min_engine_version field in pack manifests. This version specifies the minimum Minecraft version required to use the pack.

100.title: BP Version Defined
100.description: Confirms that min_engine_version is defined in the behavior pack manifest header.

110.title: BP Major Low
110.description: Warning when the behavior pack's min_engine_version major number is below the current Minecraft version. Update to access newer features.

111.title: BP Major High
111.description: Error when the behavior pack's min_engine_version major number is above the current Minecraft version. The pack may not load.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

120.title: BP Minor Low
120.description: Warning when the behavior pack's min_engine_version minor number is below the current Minecraft version.

121.title: BP Minor High
121.description: Error when the behavior pack's min_engine_version minor number is above the current Minecraft version.
121.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

130.title: BP Patch Low
130.description: Information when the behavior pack's min_engine_version patch number is below the current Minecraft version.

131.title: BP Patch High
131.description: Warning when the behavior pack's min_engine_version patch number is above the current Minecraft version.
131.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

180.title: No Manifest
180.description: Error when no manifest.json file was found in the pack root.
180.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the expected manifest path

181.title: Version Errors
181.description: Error when the min_engine_version field could not be parsed or validated.
181.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the version processing error

200.title: RP Version Defined
200.description: Confirms that min_engine_version is defined in the resource pack manifest header.

210.title: RP Major Low
210.description: Warning when the resource pack's min_engine_version major number is below the current Minecraft version.

211.title: RP Major High
211.description: Error when the resource pack's min_engine_version major number is above the current Minecraft version.
211.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

220.title: RP Minor Low
220.description: Warning when the resource pack's min_engine_version minor number is below the current Minecraft version.

221.title: RP Minor High
221.description: Error when the resource pack's min_engine_version minor number is above the current Minecraft version.
221.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

230.title: RP Patch Low
230.description: Information when the resource pack's min_engine_version patch number is below the current Minecraft version.

231.title: RP Patch High
231.description: Warning when the resource pack's min_engine_version patch number is above the current Minecraft version.
231.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version exceeding current

500.title: Version Retrieved
500.description: Status indicating the current Minecraft version was retrieved for comparison.
500.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the retrieved Minecraft version

501.title: Version Parsed
501.description: Status indicating the Minecraft version string was parsed into version numbers.
501.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the parsed version components
